name: ModelVariant173_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant173_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (particles drift from the active slot as rows of four spinning, partly textured cubes, and every masked cube fires an expanding double-ring beam on arrival); a non-negative request sets the work area up from the command row indexed by the request and prints its size, a negative one draws a frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-190/320 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant190_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, without the size print, and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
